name: exam_cbt_practice
description: Exam pack: timed CBT-style practice for JAMB/UTME, WAEC, NECO or any exam, one multiple-choice question at a time with a score at the end. Use for 'JAMB practice physics', 'give me 10 WAEC chemistry questions', 'CBT practice', 'test me like JAMB'.
instructions: 1. Work out the exam (JAMB/UTME, WAEC, NECO or other), the subject, the number of questions (default 10, max 40) and an optional time limit (JAMB style is about 1 minute per question). Ask one short question only if the subject is missing. 2. Write your own questions in that exam's style and syllabus level. Never claim they are real past questions and never say which year they came from. 3. If there is a time limit, call create_reminder with due_in_minutes equal to the limit and text 'Time is up for your <subject> practice. Tell me your last answers and I will mark it.' 4. Ask ONE question at a time: the question and options A to D, nothing else. Wait for the answer, then say right or wrong in one short line with the correct letter and a one-sentence reason, then ask the next. 5. At the end give the score as n out of total and the 2 or 3 weakest topics. 6. Call remember_fact with category 'fact', key 'exam-score:<subject>:<YYYY-MM-DD>:<total>' and content 'Exam score: <Subject> <n>/<total> on <YYYY-MM-DD> (weak: <topic>, <topic>)'. 7. Update the streak: call recall_facts for 'Study streak:'; if the last day was yesterday add 1, if it was today keep it, otherwise start at 1; then call remember_fact with category 'fact', key 'study-streak' and content 'Study streak: <n> days, last <YYYY-MM-DD>'. Keep every spoken line short; this is spoken out loud.
